raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Two small trims to the Model Runner V2 decode step with speculative decoding:

- A FULL graph whose model returns aux hidden states (EAGLE3, DFlash, DSpark, `extract_hidden_states`) copies its hidden and aux hidden states into the persistent buffers with one sliced `torch._foreach_copy_` instead of one copy kernel per tensor, when they are contiguous and share one dtype.
- Without structured outputs or a PP draft broadcast, the draft tokens are no longer gathered by `idx_mapping` for `set_draft_tokens`, which then reads only their width.

Both trim per-step work on the spec-decode output path; they matter most at low concurrency. Split out of #64364, as @zhou9402 suggested there; the PP branch follows their note about #64458.

## Claims

- Qwen3-8B on one GB300, concurrency 1: output throughput +0.27% with EAGLE3 (k=3) and +0.42% with DFlash (k=16); both well above the round-to-round spread (t = 4.0 and 15.6, 3 interleaved rounds).
- Concurrency 64: not resolved yet. One round per config read −1.2% (EAGLE3) and −0.9% (DFlash), while EAGLE3's median TPOT improved; 5 more interleaved rounds per config are queued and will replace this line.
- No arithmetic change: the copy moves the same bytes, and the draft-token rows are only read for their width on the path that skips the gather.

## Validation

**Setup:** 1× GB300, vLLM nightly image 3966924d56 with the two files mounted over the package (the arm check below confirms which code each server ran), `VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1`, a fresh server and a separate compile cache per arm, one shared FlashInfer autotune cache. `vllm bench serve`, random 1024 in / 256 out, `--ignore-eos`, temperature 0, seed 1; 30 prompts at concurrency 1, 256 at 64. Arms alternate within each round.

```bash
vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3-8B --max-model-len 8192 --max-num-seqs 64 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.85 \
  --speculative-config '{"method":"eagle3","model":"inference-optimization/Qwen3-8B-from-Qwen3-8B_regen-speculators.eagle3-qwen3arch-ckpt1","num_speculative_tokens":3}'
# DFlash: '{"method":"dflash","model":"z-lab/Qwen3-8B-DFlash-b16","num_speculative_tokens":16,"max_model_len":8192}'
vllm bench serve --backend vllm --model Qwen/Qwen3-8B --dataset-name random --random-input-len 1024 \
  --random-output-len 256 --num-prompts 30 --max-concurrency 1 --ignore-eos --temperature 0 --seed 1
```

**Concurrency 1** (output tok/s per round):

| Config | main | This PR | Δ (mean ± sd of paired rounds) |
|---|---|---|---|
| EAGLE3 k=3 | 384.83 / 385.17 / 386.48 | 385.85 / 386.66 / 387.07 | +1.03 ± 0.45 tok/s (+0.27%, t = 4.0) |
| DFlash k=16 | 518.60 / 517.10 / 517.11 | 521.04 / 519.15 / 519.10 | +2.16 ± 0.24 tok/s (+0.42%, t = 15.6) |

Median TPOT: EAGLE3 2.18 → 2.17 ms in every round; DFlash 1.95–1.96 → 1.95 ms.

These runs used an earlier revision of this branch on the 3966924d56 image, which predates #64458. The review edits since then (the helper rename, the same-dtype condition, and the restructured PP branch) do not change the path these configs take.

**Concurrency 64:**

| Config | main | This PR | Δ |
|---|---|---|---|
| EAGLE3 k=3 | 8052.22 | 7957.77 | −1.2% (1 round; median TPOT 5.49 → 5.43 ms) |
| DFlash k=16 | 5130.06 | 5081.58 | −0.9% (1 round; median TPOT 10.82 → 10.98 ms) |

Pending: rounds 2–6 per config, arm order alternating per round.

**Microbenchmark** (GB300, 100 calls captured in one CUDA graph, median of 30 replays; H = 4096, bf16):

| Tensors copied | Tokens | Per-tensor copies (µs) | One sliced `_foreach_copy_` (µs) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 4 (3 aux) | 4 / 16 / 64 | 6.26 / 7.96 / 6.53 | 1.71 / 1.72 / 2.88 |
| 4 (3 aux) | 256 / 1024 / 4096 | 8.95 / 13.23 / 50.53 | 8.23 / 9.25 / 50.86 |
| 6 (5 aux) | 4 / 16 / 64 | 11.60 / 11.83 / 12.16 | 1.70 / 1.74 / 3.11 |
| 6 (5 aux) | 256 / 1024 / 4096 | 13.35 / 26.57 / 75.72 | 8.29 / 20.64 / 74.93 |

The draft-token gather by `idx_mapping` costs 13.5–16 µs of host time per step (it launches an index kernel); the slice is a 3–4 µs view.

Pending: the same sweep at H = 7168 and 128–8192 tokens.

**Tests** (queued on the 335dd77b09 nightly, which has #64458, with this branch's two files mounted; results will be added here):

```bash
export VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1
pytest tests/v1/spec_decode/test_mtp_structured_output.py
pytest tests/v1/e2e/spec_decode/acceptance_rates/dflash/test_dflash.py -k qwen3-mrv2
pytest tests/v1/e2e/spec_decode/eagle/test_eagle_correctness.py -k 'medium and qwen3_eagle3 and not transformers'
pytest tests/v1/e2e/spec_decode/draft_model/test_structured_output_pp.py   # 2 GPUs: structured outputs + PP
pytest tests/v1/e2e/spec_decode/eagle/test_eagle3_pp.py                    # 4 GPUs: EAGLE3 + PP
```

No new tests: both changes leave every output bitwise identical, so a test of them would pass on main too. `tests/v1/worker/test_draft_tokens_handler.py` already pins that a batch without structured outputs gets placeholders of the drafts' width; it would fail if the handler started reading the rows, which is the only change that would make the view wrong. The PP path keeps main's gather, and both PP ranks use `num_speculative_steps` as the width.

## Details

- **Why the slices.** `_foreach_copy_` hands each tensor chunk to one CTA that loops over it, so a few rows of one tensor would sit on a single CTA. Splitting each flat tensor into 16 chunks of at least 4096 elements spreads a small batch over enough CTAs and keeps large batches at the per-tensor copy's speed (the 4096-token rows above).
- **Fallback.** Without aux hidden states, if an output is non-contiguous (e.g. the split views of DeepSeek-V2's sequence-parallel path), or if the dtypes differ (Muse Spark's aux states are FP32 next to BF16 hidden states, and `_foreach_copy_` then copies one slice at a time), the per-tensor copies run as before. The destination buffers are `empty_like` the largest source, so they are contiguous whenever the sources are.
- **Draft tokens.** With structured outputs, the grammar needs the actual tokens in batch order. With PP, `broadcast_drafts` (since #64458) sends the gathered tensor from a side stream, and the next step can overwrite `req_states.draft_tokens` before it is sent, so it keeps its own batch-ordered copy. Otherwise `set_draft_tokens` stores only `draft_tokens.shape[1]` per request, and a view of the first `num_reqs` rows has the same width; no reference to the view outlives the step.
- **Where the copy runs.** `store_capture_output` runs at warm-up and inside graph capture only, so the sliced copy is one node of each FULL graph and adds no host work per step.
- **Scope.** Model Runner V2 only. No new options. Measured on CUDA (GB300) only; ROCm and XPU run the same code path but were not measured.

**Not a duplicate.** Searches for the draft-token gather, `set_draft_tokens`, aux hidden state copies and FULL graph output copies found no open PR with these changes; #55575 fuses DeepSeek-V4's residual for aux hidden states (model code), and #63406 changes how these persistent buffers are allocated (a textual neighbour, not the same change).

**AI assistance.** Claude was used to find, implement and benchmark these changes and to write this description.

files.patch:
@@ -62,6 +62,13 @@
 logger = init_logger(__name__)
 
 
+def _flat_slices(t: torch.Tensor) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, ...]:
+    # _foreach_copy_ runs each 64K-element chunk of a tensor on one CTA, so
+    # spread decode-sized tensors over up to 16 CTAs.
+    flat = t.view(-1)
+    return flat.split(max(4096, -(-flat.numel() // 16)))
+
+
 class AttentionState(NamedTuple):
     attn_metadata: dict[str, Any] | None
     slot_mappings: dict[str, torch.Tensor]
@@ -657,13 +664,27 @@ def store_capture_output(num_tokens: int, model_output: Any) -> None:
                     aux_hidden_states = []
                 if self.hidden_states is None:
                     self.hidden_states = torch.empty_like(hidden_states)
-                self.hidden_states[:num_tokens] = hidden_states
                 if self.use_aux_hidden_state_outputs and not self.aux_hidden_states:
                     self.aux_hidden_states = [
                         torch.empty_like(x) for x in aux_hidden_states
                     ]
-                for i, aux in enumerate(aux_hidden_states):
-                    self.aux_hidden_states[i][:num_tokens] = aux
+                dsts = [
+                    self.hidden_states[:num_tokens],
+                    *(x[:num_tokens] for x in self.aux_hidden_states),
+                ]
+                srcs = [hidden_states, *aux_hidden_states]
+                # With mixed dtypes, _foreach_copy_ copies one slice at a time.
+                if aux_hidden_states and all(
+                    t.is_contiguous() and t.dtype == hidden_states.dtype for t in srcs
+                ):
+                    torch._foreach_copy_(
+                        [p for t in dsts for p in _flat_slices(t)],
+                        [p for t in srcs for p in _flat_slices(t)],
+                    )
+                else:
+                    self.hidden_states[:num_tokens] = hidden_states
+                    for i, aux in enumerate(aux_hidden_states):
+                        self.aux_hidden_states[i][:num_tokens] = aux
             else:
                 # Non-last PP rank.
                 assert isinstance(model_output, IntermediateTensors)

@@ -2356,13 +2356,18 @@ def sample_tokens(
         if self.num_speculative_steps > 0:
             # Spec-decode and diffusion LLMs both use draft tokens but the latter does
             # not have a speculator (i.e. self.speculator is None)
-            draft_tokens = self.req_states.draft_tokens[input_batch.idx_mapping]
+            # Drafts aren't used when none were proposed this step (e.g. skip_drafts).
+            pp_handler = self.pp_handler if num_spec_tokens > 0 else None
+            if pp_handler is not None or input_batch.has_structured_output_reqs:
+                draft_tokens = self.req_states.draft_tokens[input_batch.idx_mapping]
+            else:
+                # set_draft_tokens reads only the width; PP needs its own copy.
+                draft_tokens = self.req_states.draft_tokens[: input_batch.num_reqs]
             self.draft_tokens_handler.set_draft_tokens(
                 input_batch, draft_tokens[:, :num_spec_tokens]
             )
-            # Drafts aren't used when none were proposed this step (e.g. skip_drafts).
-            if self.pp_handler is not None and num_spec_tokens > 0:
-                self.pp_handler.broadcast_drafts(draft_tokens)
+            if pp_handler is not None:
+                pp_handler.broadcast_drafts(draft_tokens)
 
         if defer_kv_finalize:
             self.kv_connector.finalize_step()
